paragraphs: Galleriverse lets creators with no coding or 3D experience build an immersive gallery for their art. They draw rooms on a simple 2D floor plan, set each room's colours, lighting and sound, and hang artwork with titles and stories on the walls. Galleriverse compiles that layout into a 3D gallery that anyone can walk through from a shared link, on a laptop or a phone, with no account needed. The editor is the product; the 3D gallery is what it produces. Built for Hacklanta 2026 (Adobe Creative track).
features: 2D floor plan editor: rectangular rooms on a 1 m grid; add neighbours with directional + buttons, drag, resize, snap, and undo/redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z).
Three editor views: 2D, 3D POV (the real visitor tour, rendered from the live unsaved gallery), and Top-down (orbit overview).
Rooms with character: wall colour, floor finish, lighting presets, and atmosphere presets (Gallery White, Golden Hour, Neon Bunker, Moonlit, Custom) that blend as you move between rooms.
A gallery-grade look: image-based lighting, picture lights over each artwork, ceilings, baseboards, soft corner shading, textured wood/concrete/marble floors, and framed, matted artwork.
Artwork with stories: upload images (resized in the browser), add title, artist and story; visitors click a frame to read its plaque.

requirements.text: Galleriverse compiles that layout into a 3D gallery that anyone can walk through from a shared link, on a laptop or a phone, with no account needed.
Optionally create a free account, so your galleries are listed under Your galleries next time.
No accounts or API keys are needed: without storage credentials, galleries and images are saved to .data/ on your disk, and accounts use a development-only session secret.
